items.question: Plains
items.answer: Plains means flat and levelled land. Plains are thickly populated as plenty of food is grown there.

items.question: Plateau
items.answer: Plateau is a flat land and looks like a tabletop. It is higher than the surrounding area. The land is rough here.

items.question: Peninsula
items.answer: An area of land surrounded by water on three sides is known as a peninsula.

items.question: Desert
items.answer: A desert is a vast area of flat land covered with sand.

items.question: Island
items.answer: An island is a piece of land surrounded by water on all sides.

items.question: List the physical divisions of India.
items.answer: The main physical divisions of India are mountains, plains, plateaus, desert and islands.

items.question: Why is life tough in the desert?
items.answer: The life of the people living in the desert area is very difficult because it is very dry land with very little rainfall. It is also very hot here.

items.question: While travelling to the coastal areas, you do not need to carry woollen clothes. Why is it so?
items.answer: The climate in the coastal plain is neither very hot nor very cold. Therefore, you do not need to carry woollen clothes while travelling to the coastal areas.

items.question: Write a short note on the Himalayas.
items.answer: The great Himalayas form the northern boundary of our country. It is the world's highest mountain range. It is mostly covered with snow.

items.question: Why is the Deccan Plateau not fertile?
items.answer: The rivers in the Deccan Plateau depend on the rains for water. So, they become dry in summer and also when rainfall is poor. As a result, the Deccan Plateau is not very fertile.

items.question: Why do people prefer to live in the Gangetic plains and not in the Himalayas?
items.answer: The Gangetic plains have fertile land and flat ground, making farming and living easy. In the Himalayas, the land is steep and cold, so farming and living are harder.

items.question: What is the difference between plains and plateau?
answer: Plains: Plains mean flat and levelled land. Plateau: The plateau is flat and looks like a tabletop.
Plains: It is a fertile land. Plateau: It is a rough land.
Plains: Example - Indo-Gangetic Plains. Plateau: Example - Deccan Plateau.

items.question: Gagan wants to start a farm in India. He is confused and does not know which area he should choose. Tell him which area would be the best choice and why. Give a reason for your answer.
items.answer: Gagan should choose the great plains to start a farm because it has flat and levelled land. Also, the land of this area is very fertile because many rivers flow through these plains.
